svg.title: From a hidden flip to a useful CAPTCHA
svg.desc: Illustrated product concept. A market displays two public pictures and two locked placeholders for real IdenaAI 2 and 3 flips. A service buys unlocking keys. A visitor sees a complete public demonstration flip in a website CAPTCHA and chooses the sensible picture order. These are concept screens, not the current app.
svg.text: A new use for puzzles people have already solved.
Authors supply the puzzles. A service buys access. Visitors just solve.
Picture puzzles, available by the key
Which order tells a sensible story?
No wallet. No purchase for the visitor.
Past validation work could become a useful, paid resource.
Real IdenaAI previews on the left. Public Idena demonstration puzzle on the right.
